f.title: Keep the PV programme registration valid with up-to-date PV referent and legal representative
f.statement: Marketing authorisation holders, pharmaceutical laboratories and manufacturing establishments must keep their registration with the National Pharmacovigilance Programme valid and keep the information on the pharmacovigilance referent and the legal representative up to date.
f.clause: IV.a Pautas para la inscripción a la Red Nacional de Farmacovigilancia

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holders, pharmaceutical laboratories and manufacturing establishments
rows.quote: Los titulares de registros sanitarios, laboratorios farmacéuticos, establecimientos fabricantes deben tener la inscripción al Programa Nacional de Farmacovigilancia vigente y contar con la información actualizada del Referente de Farmacovigilancia y del representante legal.
rows.location: IV.a Pautas para la inscripción a la Red Nacional de Farmacovigilancia
rows.review_note: Review: guidance restating the Art. 5 duty with added detail; "deben" = Mandatory although the document is guidance (criterio orientador). Re-translation agrees. Double-check: within quote.
rows.quote_en: Marketing authorisation holders, pharmaceutical laboratories and manufacturing establishments must have a valid registration with the National Pharmacovigilance Programme and have up-to-date information on the Pharmacovigilance Referent and the legal representative.

f.title: Update the PV referent via the virtual-classroom procedure and keep the same PNF code
f.statement: The pharmacovigilance referent must be updated following the procedure in the instructions on the INVIMA virtual classroom; changes to business name, tax number (NIT), e-mail addresses and addresses are requested by e-mail to INVIMA. When updating the referent, the company must select the site to which the update applies so that no new PNF code is generated and traceability of its user is kept.
f.clause: IV.a Pautas para la inscripción a la Red Nacional de Farmacovigilancia

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holders, pharmaceutical laboratories and manufacturing establishments
rows.quote: Recuerde que para no generar un nuevo código PNF y conservar la trazabilidad en su usuario, al actualizar el Referente de Farmacovigilancia, debe seleccionar la sede para la cual aplica la actualización.
rows.location: IV.a Pautas para la inscripción a la Red Nacional de Farmacovigilancia
rows.review_note: Review: first sentence of the statement (virtual-classroom procedure, data changes by e-mail) comes from the preceding paragraph; e-mail address omitted. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: 86.
rows.quote_en: Remember that, in order not to generate a new PNF code and to keep traceability in your user account, when updating the Pharmacovigilance Referent you must select the site to which the update applies.

f.title: Renew the eReporting Industria course certificate every year
f.statement: The pharmacovigilance responsible person must update the certificate of completion of the INVIMA eReporting Industria virtual-classroom course every year, because reporting processes are constantly updated; INVIMA may change the annual periodicity when content is updated.
f.clause: IV.a Pautas para la inscripción a la Red Nacional de Farmacovigilancia (Aclaración)

rows.quote: Aclaración: El responsable de Farmacovigilancia debe actualizar el certificado de aprobación del curso del Aula Virtual de Invima eReporting Industria, anualmente, debido a las actualizaciones constantes de los procesos relacionados con el reporte.
rows.location: IV.a Pautas para la inscripción a la Red Nacional de Farmacovigilancia (Aclaración)
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Clarification: The Pharmacovigilance responsible person must update the certificate of approval of the INVIMA eReporting Industria Virtual Classroom course annually, due to the constant updates of the processes related to reporting.

f.title: Report every adverse event that harms the patient, including errors, overdose, off-label and failure
f.statement: All adverse events that cause harm to the patient must be reported, whether caused by a medication error (category D and above), overdose, off-label use or therapeutic failure. Events that cause no harm to the patient are not to be reported.
f.clause: IV.b Contenido del reporte de eventos adversos y/o problemas relacionados con medicamentos

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holders, pharmaceutical laboratories and manufacturing establishments
rows.quote: Se debe reportar todos los eventos adversos que causen daño al paciente, bien sea por un error de medicación (Tipo D en adelante1), daño por sobredosis, daño posterior al uso fuera de indicación (off-label) y daño por fallo terapéutico. Aquellos eventos que no causen daño en el paciente no serán motivo de reporte.
rows.location: IV.b Contenido del reporte de eventos adversos y/o problemas relacionados con medicamentos
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: All adverse events that cause harm to the patient must be reported, whether due to a medication error (category D onwards), harm from overdose, harm after off-label use, or harm from therapeutic failure. Events that do not cause harm to the patient shall not be reportable.

f.title: Include minimum data in fatal-case reports or INVIMA may delete them
f.statement: Fatal-outcome reports are reportable only where a possible association exists between an adverse reaction and the death, with at least the medicine, administration date, adverse reaction, reaction onset date and case narrative; where reported fatal cases do not meet these minimum conditions, INVIMA will decide whether to keep or delete the report from its database.
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; ICSR quality control

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holders, pharmaceutical laboratories and manufacturing establishments
rows.quote: Nota: Si los eventos adversos fatales reportados no cumplen las condiciones mínimas indicadas, el Invima definirá la pertinencia de conservar o eliminar este reporte de nuestra base de información.
rows.review_note: Review: the note states INVIMA's consequence; minimum content restated from Art. 8 par. 3 quoted in the guide. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: company duty implied, 85.
rows.quote_en: Note: If the fatal adverse events reported do not meet the minimum conditions indicated, INVIMA will determine whether it is appropriate to keep or delete this report from our database.

f.title: File the outsourcing agreement via the INVIMA Virtual Office with responsibilities and conditions
f.statement: The holder or manufacturer must send INVIMA, through the Oficina Virtual correspondence channel, the document supporting the responsibilities (for example confidentiality agreement, description and scope of functions, contract validity) and reporting conditions (for example management of eReporting Industria credentials, traceability evidence of reports made) of the outsourced company, without this exempting it from responsibility to the Pharmacovigilance Programme and for reporting. Outsourcing refers to safety-reporting activities under Article 13.

rows.quote: El titular del registro sanitario o fabricante debe enviar a Invima, a través de correspondencia Oficina Virtual - Invima, el documento que soporte las responsabilidades (por ejemplo acuerdo de confidencialidad, descripción y alcance de las funciones, vigencia del contrato, entre otros) y condiciones del reporte (por ejemplo, manejo de las credenciales para el reporte a través de eReporting industria, soportes de la trazabilidad de los reportes realizados, entre otros), que ejercerá la compañía tercerizada, sin que esto los exima de toda responsabilidad con el Programa de Farmacovigilancia y el reporte.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: The marketing authorisation holder or manufacturer must send INVIMA, through the INVIMA Virtual Office correspondence, the document supporting the responsibilities (for example confidentiality agreement, description and scope of functions, contract term, among others) and conditions of reporting (for example, management of credentials for reporting through eReporting Industria, evidence of traceability of reports made, among others) that the outsourced company will exercise, without this exempting them from all responsibility to the Pharmacovigilance Programme and for reporting.

f.title: Report vital-unavailable-medicine AEs through eReporting Industria when holding a user account
f.statement: If the public or private entity granted the import and/or marketing permit for a vital medicine not available has an eReporting Industria user, it must report adverse events related to that medicine through the platform following the virtual-classroom instructions; if it outsources reporting, it must follow the outsourcing rules of Article 13.

rows.actor: Public or private entity authorised to import vital medicines not available
rows.quote: Si la entidad pública o privada (a quien se le otorga el permiso de importación y/o comercialización), tiene usuario en eReporting industria, esta entidad deberá realizar el reporte relacionado con el medicamento vital no disponible, a través de esta plataforma conforme al instructivo dispuesto en el Aula Virtual del curso eReporting Industria
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: If the public or private entity (to which the import and/or marketing permit is granted) has a user in eReporting Industria, this entity shall make the report related to the vital medicine not available through this platform in accordance with the instructions provided in the Virtual Classroom of the eReporting Industria course

f.title: Request eReporting Industria access for vital-unavailable-medicine reporting
f.statement: Entities importing vital medicines not available do not hold the registration and therefore have no eReporting Industria access, but this does not exempt them from reporting; they must request access to the tool by e-mail to INVIMA under External Circular 3000-0471-2021. Health-care providers authorised to import or manufacture such medicines report adverse events through VigiFlow.

rows.actor: Public or private entity authorised to import vital medicines not available
rows.quote: Sin embargo, esto no exime de la responsabilidad de reporte, por lo tanto, estas entidades deben solicitar el respectivo acceso a la herramienta a través del correo electrónico
rows.review_note: Review: e-mail address and circular number left out of the quote (address not allowed in the file); circular named in legal_basis. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: 88.
rows.quote_en: However, this does not exempt them from the responsibility to report; therefore, these entities must request the respective access to the tool by e-mail

f.title: Provide INVIMA with further information on vital-unavailable-medicine AEs, alerts and recalls
f.statement: When a safety situation arises with vital medicines not available, INVIMA will request authorised companies to extend the adverse event information so it can assess causality and close the report; if any authorised medicine is involved in an alert or recall monitored by the Pharmacovigilance Group, information will also be requested according to the case. Companies must provide it.

rows.actor: Public or private entity authorised to import vital medicines not available
rows.quote: estaremos requiriendo ampliar información del evento adverso a las empresas autorizadas, para evaluar su causalidad y dar el cierre del reporte.
rows.review_note: Review: INVIMA states it will request information; the duty to respond is implied. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: implied company duty, 82.
rows.quote_en: we will be requiring the authorised companies to extend the information on the adverse event, in order to assess its causality and close the report.

f.title: Load eReporting Industria reports manually or by XML file
f.statement: Reports may be loaded into eReporting Industria either by manual entry or by uploading an XML file.

rows.quote: Nota: El cargue de información del reporte a través de eReporting Industria se podrá realizar a través del cargue manual o archivo XML
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Note: Report information may be loaded through eReporting Industria by manual upload or XML file.

f.title: Be ready for announced or unannounced PV inspections
f.statement: INVIMA reserves the right to give or not give notice of inspection visits to the pharmacovigilance programme of holders, manufacturers, pharmaceutical laboratories and importers; the inspection guide for follow-up visits to industry pharmacovigilance programmes is published on the INVIMA website.
f.processes: Audit & inspection readiness; Quality system & CAPA

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holders, manufacturers, pharmaceutical laboratories and importers where applicable
rows.quote: Invima se reserva el derecho de notificar o no la visita de inspección al programa de farmacovigilancia de los titulares del registro, fabricantes y laboratorios farmacéuticos e importadores cuando aplique
rows.review_note: Review: authority prerogative; company consequence is continuous readiness for unannounced inspections. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: implied duty, 85.
rows.quote_en: INVIMA reserves the right to notify or not the inspection visit to the pharmacovigilance programme of marketing authorisation holders, manufacturers and pharmaceutical laboratories and importers where applicable
